The '''77th Air Wing''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] that operated during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The wing was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]] and was made up of at least one [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]: [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. Sword Squadron consisted of three flights: [[Blade Flight]], [[Dagger Flight]], and [[Scimitar Flight]], which all flew [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]]. The 77th Air Wing participated in the [[Western Reaches Operation]], a campaign initiated by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to drive the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] from the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] the wing was deployed during a [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]].
